description: Replays every recording in the folder and reports, in plain English, what still works and what broke - with the button or page that went missing and a line to paste back into an AI tool. Call it after every change to the app, and do not call a change done until it passes. If it says nothing has been recorded, use kryptheon_record first.

folder.description: Absolute path of the project folder - normally the workspace root. Recordings are kept in its tests/ folder. Defaults to the folder this server was started in.

name: kryptheon_check
title: Replay every recording and say what broke
